component.name: CableDesk
component.summary: Direct wired desktop connection over USB4 or Thunderbolt

description.p: CableDesk connects two Linux computers over a direct USB4 or Thunderbolt cable and provides an ultra-low-latency, near-local desktop-control experience. It is an automation and integration layer around Sunshine and Moonlight, not a replacement for either.

CableDesk is an experimental project. An ordinary USB-C cable and port do not guarantee compatibility: both computers need genuine USB4 or Thunderbolt support. See the project README for current limitations.
Initial experimental foundation: read-only compatibility detection for Fedora Workstation. No pairing, networking or streaming yet.
